_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Religion-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching mechanism, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test. Belief-content, identity, and adversarial failures with no E/I-dynamical analog are marked UNMAPPED, never force-fit.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

INSTITUTIONAL_ABUSE.religion_text: canonical circuit vmPFC[Hypo]: "top-down inhibitory brake — brake-fail=rogue"; _authored dlPFC[Hyper-concentrated]: "Unchecked executive authority enabling cover-ups"; vmPFC[Hypo-active]: "Moral reasoning systems overridden by institutional self-preservation"; summary: "Religious authority exploited for personal gain, sexual predation, or coercive control"
INSTITUTIONAL_ABUSE.reasoning: The named mechanism is explicitly the loss of the top-down INHIBITORY BRAKE ('brake-fail=rogue'), with the _authored circuit showing unchecked executive authority and overridden moral-reasoning brakes. Losing the inhibitor and releasing rogue/runaway activity is the exact DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME definition (loss of the stop/brake). Strongest grounding of the set.

RADICALIZATION.reason: Named canonical mechanism ('priors-too-strong') is an aberrant-precision predictive-coding fault NOT enumerated among the 9 Part XIV classes; the domain mechanism is adversarial belief-content / ideological capture with no E/I-dynamical analog.
RADICALIZATION.religion_text: canonical circuit dACC[Hyper]: "conflict/error monitor — priors-too-strong"; _authored WERN[Altered]: "Scripture selectively quoted and decontextualized to support violent ideology"; AG[Altered]: "Religious education replaced with indoctrination — critical inquiry forbidden"; summary: "Vulnerable individuals recruited into extremist religious ideologies — violence justified through theological distortion"
RADICALIZATION.reasoning: 'priors-too-strong' in a conflict/error monitor is aberrant PRECISION/PRIOR weighting (Part XIII.5 predictive coding): top-down priors so strong that bottom-up prediction error can no longer update the model. The 9 Part XIV classes are all E/I-dynamics archetypes (excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation, degeneration); NONE expresses a prediction-error / prior-precision failure. The domain content — indoctrination, decontextualized scripture, theological distortion — is adversarial belief-content capture / information-integrity corruption, structurally the same kind of failure as Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL (confabulation/deception). Reading it as OSCILLATORY_PATHOLOGY over-coupling (hypersynchrony 'locked to one prior') would be a force-fit: hypersynchrony is oscillatory coupling, not belief-prior precision. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.
RADICALIZATION.note: THIS IS THE KEY HETEROGENEITY FINDING. Religion carries a failure archetype (ideological capture via aberrant prior/precision + belief-content distortion) that the E/I-dynamics neuro-substrate taxonomy structurally cannot represent — the Religion analog of Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL.

SECULARIZATION_CRISIS.subtype: progressive cross-generational transmission/maintenance failure -> network atrophy
SECULARIZATION_CRISIS.religion_text: canonical circuit mPFC[Hypo]: "medial PFC — self-referential value integration (DMN core) — disengaged, apathetic"; _authored HIPP[Hypo-transmitted]: "Sacred narratives no longer part of cultural memory — mythological literacy declining across generations"; AG[Hypo-enrolled]: "next-generation formation pipeline collapsing"; PIN[Hypo-populated]: "contemplative traditions at risk of extinction"; summary: "Institutional religion losing adherents, cultural relevance, and transmissive capacity — meaning vacuum expanding"
SECULARIZATION_CRISIS.reasoning: The pervasive Hypo/withdrawal profile (disengaged, apathetic; transmission failing across generations; formation pipeline collapsing; traditions at risk of extinction) is a progressive MAINTENANCE/TRANSMISSION failure compounding over time with NETWORK ATROPHY — the NEURODEGENERATION archetype ('failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time'), which is uniquely the class capturing slow, cross-generational, network-wide decline rather than an acute dynamical fault.
SECULARIZATION_CRISIS.note: PARTIAL-FIT divergence: the canonical NEURODEGENERATION definition includes an 'aggregation' sub-feature that SECULARIZATION lacks (this is atrophy/attrition, not aggregation). Classed on the compounding maintenance/transmission-failure-over-time + network-collapse core, which is the dominant match. An alternative reading as global under-excitation -> silence (CSD-adjacent) was rejected because there is no depolarization wave; the cross-generational, compounding character is the deciding cue.

THEOLOGICAL_SCHISM.religion_text: canonical circuit dlPFC[Hyper]: "dorsolateral PFC — executive working-memory / cognitive control — rigidity/rumination-lock"; _authored DMN[Hyper-divergent]: "Competing theological narratives becoming mutually incomprehensible — shared meaning fracturing"; WERN[Hyper-contested]: "same texts used to justify opposing positions"; dlPFC[Hyper-factional]: "fragmenting into competing governance structures and parallel hierarchies"; summary: "Irreconcilable doctrinal disputes fragmenting religious communities — institutional unity collapsing"
THEOLOGICAL_SCHISM.reasoning: Schism is the decoupling/fragmentation case. Per XIII.3, groups that oscillate INCOHERENTLY are functionally disconnected; 'mutually incomprehensible... shared meaning fracturing... parallel hierarchies' is exactly UNDER-COUPLING / loss of communication-through-coherence = OSCILLATORY_PATHOLOGY (which the definition states covers over- AND under-coupling, both degrading communication).
THEOLOGICAL_SCHISM.note: Node-cue vs summary CONVERGE at the class level: the canonical dlPFC cue names 'rigidity/rumination-lock' (an over-coupling / stuck-attractor flavor) while the _authored circuit names 'mutually incomprehensible / fragmenting' (under-coupling). Both extremes are the same Part XIV class (OSCILLATORY_PATHOLOGY). This is the grounded schism=decoupling mapping the domain note anticipated.

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Religion mapping must preserve an analogous fast-action / slow-governance separation, or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
